_comment: The New MMFDB sample dialog: the common fields of a sample definition, drawn by view_form against the app's SampleFields proxy (each attr reads and writes one key of the app's sample_definition JSON, which stays the full record shown under Advanced).

sections.label: Sample name
sections.description: Sample identity recorded with the shifted files' provenance.

sections.label: Description
sections.description: Free-text description of the sample and the experiment.

sections.label: Buffer
sections.description: Buffer composition recorded with the sample.

sections.label: Construct sequence
sections.description: Sequence of the measured construct; compared with the reference to document mutations.

sections.label: UniProt accession
sections.description: UniProt entry the reference sequence is fetched from.

sections.label: Reference sequence
sections.description: Reference (wild-type) sequence, fetched from UniProt or typed.

buttons.label: Fetch UniProt reference
buttons.description: Retrieve reference sequence and organism without blocking the interface.

buttons.label: Diff construct/reference
buttons.description: Record residue substitutions between the measured construct and its reference.

sections.label: Donor dye
sections.description: Name of the donor probe on the first entity.

sections.label: Acceptor dye
sections.description: Name of the acceptor probe on the first entity.
